name: Martha Laurent
life: “I still remember building my first bench out of a crate marked tomatoes.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Martha by a small Wednesday habit. Martha notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I am a tenant on the same street. I can't move a fence but I can share the bench I built from packing wood.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an unlined tan jacket and a little coil of soft measuring tape. Martha has a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth, with a high puff tied with plain cord. Martha draws small circles on a tabletop while waiting during a conversation.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Martha takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To loan a handmade bench for shared use.
family: Tara Dean is Martha’s second cousin. Martha is free to hang up first. Tara makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *One paid trial*, Tara says, “I sponsored the trial wage. My name can stay off the winner's contract.”
connections: Peyton Myers. A loaned bench and two salt pots give different households real things they can still choose separately.

reactions.situation: The older neighbors disagree on where the gate should go
reactions.response: Martha gets both neighbors to mark a trial gate position before any hedge is cut.

reactions.situation: A neighbor offers to pay for a favor that was meant kindly
reactions.response: Martha asks for help with a task the neighbor does well, so both people get to contribute something.
